item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:15 HKT 04/Feb/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The winter monsoon now affecting the coast of Guangdong is expected to be replaced by an easterly airstream tomorrow night, temperatures will rise slightly over the region in the following couple of days. An upper-air disturbance will bring rainy weather to southern China early next week. Another surge of the monsoon will affect Guangdong midweek next week and temperatures will fall again over the region.
